app.tagline: A lesson in a photo, an Anki deck.

profile.switched: 👤 Anki profile: {profile}. Their lessons are in 📚.

prompt.title: Instructions
prompt.fromPromptHint: No photo? The AI creates the cards from your prompt: put the words in it, or ask for a topic. Check the cards carefully.

review.title: Review
review.voiceDevice: 🔊 Read aloud by the device in {voice}.
review.noCards: No cards found: check the photos or the instructions.
review.readOnly: 🔒 Read only: only {owner}'s profile can change it. You can still add it to your Anki.

revise.label: Correct the cards with AI
revise.placeholder: ✨ Correct with AI: “remove the card about father”, “you forgot the colours”…

send.confirmOtherProfile:

Switch profiles in Anki, or press OK to send it to “{active_profile}” anyway.

export.noSound: Deck exported, but {count} card(s) without sound (text-to-speech unavailable).

audio.failed: Can't play: unknown voice or text-to-speech unavailable.

editor.name: Name
editor.textPlaceholder: E.g. Create English → French Anki cards with the vocabulary of the lesson…
editor.deckHint: Parts in braces are filled in from the lesson.
editor.voiceHint: Type the start of the language (“fr-FR”, “es-ES”…) to see the voices. Empty = no sound.
editor.required: A name and a text are required.

create.title: 🔐 Create the password
create.hint: This page holds the API keys. Choose a password to protect it: other users of the app won't be able to open it.

provider.title: AI model

gemini.name: Gemini (Google)
gemini.description: Fast and cheap. A free tier exists, but it is sometimes overloaded.

anthropic.name: Claude (Anthropic)
anthropic.description: Very good reading, handwriting included. Paid, a few cents per lesson.

openai.name: OpenAI-compatible (OpenAI, OpenRouter…)
openai.description: OpenAI, or OpenRouter: one key for GPT, Claude, Gemini, Mistral… “Other” accepts any compatible service (Ollama, LM Studio…).

fake.name: Demo
fake.description: Canned cards, to try the app without a key.

provider.modelHint: Leave empty for the default model.
provider.fallbacksHint: Tried in order when the main model is overloaded (comma-separated).

access.title: Access
access.openaiKey: Service API key (not needed for a local service)
access.replaceHint: To replace it, paste the new key.
access.willBeCleared: Will be deleted when you save.
access.ollamaHint: OpenAI-compatible service: its address usually ends with /v1 (local Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1).
access.testOk: ✓ {model} reads images and answers in the right format ({seconds} s).
access.testNoVision: ⚠ {model} answers, but doesn't seem to see the image (it said “{answer}” for a red square). Pick a model that accepts images.
access.testNoJson: ⚠ {model} doesn't answer in the requested JSON format: pick another model.
access.testRefused: ⚠ {model} doesn't accept images (“{refused}”). Pick a vision model.

voice.title: Card voices
voice.hint: The voice itself is chosen in each set of instructions.

anki.title: 📥 Send straight to Anki
anki.embedded: ✓ Cartable runs inside the Anki add-on: “Add to Anki” writes straight into the open profile, no AnkiConnect needed.
anki.howTo: To add cards without an .apkg file: in Anki on the computer, Tools → Add-ons → Get Add-ons, code 2055492159 (AnkiConnect), then restart Anki. Anki must be open while sending. Or install the Cartable add-on, which runs Cartable inside Anki.
anki.addressHint: Anki on the same computer as Cartable: http://localhost:8765.
anki.keyPlaceholder: Only if “apiKey” is set in AnkiConnect
anki.syncHint: (to get the cards on the phone)
anki.allProfilesViewHint: (“All profiles” switch in 📚; unchecked, each profile only sees its own and shared lessons)

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.hint: Who each lesson belongs to. A lesson can only be changed from its owner's Anki profile; one without owner is everyone's. Changes here apply right away.
lessons.ankiClosed: Anki isn't reachable: open it to choose among its profiles.
lessons.confirmDelete: Delete the lesson "{deck}" for every profile? Its photos and cards are removed.

service.title: Service
service.vision: Pick a model that accepts images (vision).

modelsVision.one: {count} model accepting images, suggested in the list.
modelsVision.other: {count} models accepting images, suggested in the list.

modelsAll.other: {count} models suggested: the service doesn't say which accept images, check with “Test”.

lesson.read_only: Read only: only {owner}'s Anki profile can change this lesson.

extract.no_input: Add a photo, or write a prompt.

llm.missing_model: No model chosen: pick one in the settings (⚙️).
llm.missing_key: No {provider} key: add it in the settings (⚙️).
llm.invalid_key: Invalid {provider} key: check it in the settings (⚙️).

llm.refused: The model refused to process these images.
llm.missing_url: Enter the service address in the settings (⚙️).

anki.unreachable: Anki can't be reached: start Anki on the computer.
anki.bad_response: Unexpected answer: is AnkiConnect really at this address?
anki.no_profile: No profile open in Anki: open a profile and try again.
anki.sync_not_logged_in: Anki is not logged in to AnkiWeb: click “Sync” once in Anki to log in
anki.profile_mismatch: This lesson is for “{lesson_profile}”, but the “{active_profile}” profile is open in Anki.

tts.no_preview_for_anki_locale: An Anki locale (es_ES) has no preview: the device reads it aloud.

admin.local_only: Settings open from Anki, on the computer: Tools → Cartable → Settings.

addon.uv_unsupported: This computer isn't supported (no uv for it): install uv yourself (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), then restart Anki.
addon.uv_download_failed: Couldn't download uv from GitHub (see the log). Check the Internet connection, then Tools → Cartable → Restart the server.
addon.install_failed: Couldn't install Cartable's dependencies (see the log).

addon.stoppedAtStart: The Cartable server stopped while starting.
addon.phoneSteps:
1. Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
2. Scan this QR code with the phone's camera.
3. In the browser: menu → “Add to Home screen”, to use it like an app.

Settings (AI keys…) open here, on the computer: Tools → Cartable → Settings.
addon.localOnly: ⚠ The server only listens on this computer (“host” set to 127.0.0.1): set “0.0.0.0” in the add-on config to reach it from the phone.
addon.notRunningYet: Cartable is starting: try again in a few seconds.
addon.installConfirm:
Before it can start, Cartable must install its components:

• uv (from GitHub), Python 3.13 and its Python libraries (from PyPI): about 300 MB on disk;
• only in the add-on's own folder: nothing changes on the rest of the computer, and removing the add-on removes them.

This takes a minute or two, the first time and after some updates. Install now?
addon.installDeclined: Cartable isn't started. To install it later: Tools → Cartable → Open Cartable.

defaultPrompts.name: Vocabulary EN → ES
defaultPrompts.text: Create English → Spanish Anki cards with the vocabulary of the lesson. One word or expression per card. Front in English, back in Spanish with the article for nouns (el/la). In "info", give the gender, the plural when it is irregular, and a short example if the lesson has one.

defaultPrompts.name: Sentences EN → ES
defaultPrompts.text: Create English → Spanish Anki cards with the complete sentences of the lesson. Front: the sentence in English. Back: the sentence in Spanish.

defaultPrompts.name: Questions / answers
defaultPrompts.text: Create question → answer cards to review the content of the lesson (dates, definitions, key ideas). Short, precise questions and brief answers, in English.
